statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study (CPT 93247) is clinically indicated
The service is to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias (R42)
The claim was for CPT code 93247
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
